name: What are the common utility requirements for an outdoor barbecue island?

mainEntity.name: What are the common utility requirements for an outdoor barbecue island?

acceptedAnswer.text: The utility requirements for an outdoor barbecue island typically include natural gas or propane for the grill and other cooking appliances, electrical outlets for refrigeration, lighting, or rotisserie motors, and plumbing for a sink or wet bar. The specific hookups needed depend entirely on the features you choose to include in your design. Hometelligent Inc. conducts a thorough site assessment to determine existing utility access and plan for any necessary extensions or new installations, ensuring all connections are up to code and safely integrated into the island's structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common utility requirements include natural gas/propane, electricity for appliances and lighting, and plumbing for sinks. Hometelligent Inc. assesses existing utility access to plan for safe and code-compliant integrations.
